text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn). It's one of the
most prestigious races where everyone strives
for the esteemed Shield, but—
(Shaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaain!?
Seriously, rain on top of everything else...?

Even the sky was overcast this year.
In her heart, Mejiro Palmer counted up
the many heavy burdens...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (The Tenno Sho (Autumn)... Along with the Spring edition, it's a monumental race that the Mejiro family holds in the highest regard...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(The track's pure mud...
It's a total soggy mud party,
and my vibes are so, so down...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow, ow...
My shoulders are super stiff, and my legs are totally swollen, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (My bestie is also totally wiped from medium-distance training. Even her smile is stiffer than usual...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You've arrived, Teio-san.
Well then, let us begin Act Two.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, McQueen. Today's the day I shut you up
for good. The star of the show is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(And the opponents are... main characters
born carrying destiny on their shoulders!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of that—can you get hyped?
—Can you laugh?
—Can you fly? CAN YOU FLY?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Can you truly—party like crazy from the bottom of your heart!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course we can, dammit!!!!!!!
Don't underestimate us! Galapago MAX!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro renegade, Mejiro Palmer!!!!!
Feast your eyes on the running of me and my bestie, and let your souls be shaken!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Palmer...!? You...
On this historic stage...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds super fun, nice, nice!
I actually really like this kind of vibe!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bestie☆
I just got a total brainwave, yo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be fun if we two went head-to-head today?
What do ya think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, the two of us... racing against each other?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yup! I mean, the weather's super gloomy, and our rival Uma-peeps are crazy tough!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So ya gotta go all out from the start
and sparkle, no matter how much overtakin'
goes down, right☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wanna do it? Wanna show 'em?
Our totally fab match race☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Matchy-match...
Matchy-match with Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, don't mind if I do!
We're gonna—me and my BFF are gonna—
make this race the MAX-est hype in history!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna make it fun!!!
Everyone, keep your eyes on meee!!!
Whoooo~~~!!!"
Mejiro Palmer pulled off the performance she hadn't been able to do during the Tenno Sho (Spring) with absolute perfection—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I did it...! I pulled it off...!
I cleared the biggest hurdle of them all—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, I'll show it off in the race too!
That our friendship is the absolute greatest!"

A wild, soaring cry piercing through the rain clouds.
Mejiro Palmer dances across a rain-soaked Fuchu
alongside her BFF, Daitaku Helios.
